concerns.text: T003 is tagged [P] and the execution-order note says it 'may run in parallel with [T004] once T002 completes', but both T003 and T004 write their output back to the SAME file, data/curated/filtered.csv, in place. Running them in parallel creates a read/write race on the single source of truth (T004 reads filtered.csv to compute baseline_shift_eV while T003 rewrites it with engineered features). Either remove the [P] tag / parallel claim, or have the tasks write distinct intermediate files with a final merge.

T005 (end-to-end data pipeline run) is correctly sequenced before Phase 2, but its verification ('schema-validation script over data/curated/filtered.csv passes') references a script no task creates. Name the script or fold the check into T005's own implementation so the ordering of producer/consumer for the validator is explicit.
